name: Hebi no Cinderella
source:
Saki Kiyuki is a plain, frugal 30-year old cleaning lady who has given up on any hopes and dreams she held on to once.
Her life turns around after an incident where she ends up standing up for a salaryman who was falsely accused of molesting another passenger during her morning commute. The man, Rei Sannomiya, befriends Saki and slowly she regains some optimism in her future.

They meet, grow closer, fall in love... And then...
A modern-day suspense problematic yandere villain visual novel.

[Translated from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/girls/announce/=/product_id/RJ218671.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
清木咲希是一名朴素节俭的30岁清洁工，早已放弃曾经拥有的希望与梦想。

某天早高峰通勤时，她为一名被诬陷骚扰其他乘客的上班族挺身而出，人生因此改变。男子三宫玲与咲希成为朋友，她也逐渐恢复了对未来的乐观。

他们相遇、亲近、相爱……然后……

一部现代悬疑问题系病娇反派视觉小说。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/girls/announce/=/product_id/RJ218671.html]DLsite[/url]]
